why: An issue-scoped plan lets plain /git-triage run post a settled brief, and it does not rerun a waiting row whose question is still unanswered.

issues.author: carol
issues.body:
## Problem
parse_date('2024-02-30') returns March 1 instead of raising.

## Expected
Invalid calendar dates raise ValueError.

## Acceptance
- [ ] parse_date raises ValueError for 2024-02-30
- [ ] Valid dates still parse

issues.author: dave
issues.body: When a session expires mid-edit, we lose the draft. Either redirect to login and restore the draft afterwards, or show an inline re-login modal that keeps the page. Product has not picked one.

comments.author: erin
comments.body: I prefer the modal, but the PM wants the redirect. Needs a decision.
